summary: Iteration 3 testing: Image upload backend endpoints and frontend UI (cover image uploader, RTE image button, blog preview modal). All 7 backend tests pass, all 15 frontend features verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Image data stored as base64 in MongoDB - works for small images but may hit BSON document size limit (16MB) for larger images. Consider GridFS for production.
RTE uses deprecated execCommand('insertHTML') - works in current browsers but may break in future. No critical fix needed now.
No brute force lockout (noted from previous iterations, still not implemented)
seed_data_creation: 1x1 PNG uploaded to /api/upload/image during backend test (stored in MongoDB images collection)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 iteration-3 features fully working: (1) Cover image uploader: drag-and-drop zone, file input, URL toggle, thumbnail preview with Replace/Remove hover overlay. (2) RTE Image button (ImagePlus icon, title='Insert Image') triggers hidden rte-image-file-input. (3) Preview modal: opens with post title/category/author, shows 'Not yet saved' badge, Close Preview button dismisses it. Backend: POST /api/upload/image stores base64 in MongoDB, GET /api/images/{id} returns raw image bytes with correct content-type. All data-testid attributes working.
